item.coloph: de ltar rgyud lung bon sgo'i yang snying don/ gdams pa'i bcud 'dus go rims (rim) le'u brgyad pa/ zab don man ngag 'phrul gyi sgron ma zhes/ rjes 'jug don phyir se zhig kho bo yis/ 'dir bkod 'gal 'khrul ra chod ci mchis gang*/ bder gshegs rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la bshags/ dge byung 'gro kun byang chub myur thob shog/
